item.title: Monty Hall Problem
item.author: Vaibhav Thakor
item.description: Let’s say you are in a game show and there are 3 doors. Behind 2 doors there are goats and behind the remaining one door there is a car. You do not know what’s behind which door and are asked to choose one door. Next, the host will reveal the door behind which there is a goat. Then the host asks you whether you want to switch your choice with the other closed door or not. Question is, Should you switch or not?
